metadata.coordinate_policy: Every point is an approximate region-level locator; NOT an excavated feature, dive coordinate, survey result, or navigation aid.
metadata.data_policy: Publicly cited historical scholarship and high-level region locations only. No sensitive site coordinates or archaeological looting targets.
metadata.source_policy: Classification applies to the cited interpretation, not authoritativeness of a media headline.

properties.name: Pavlopetri
properties.period: Occupation from at least c. 3500 BCE
properties.summary: Submerged town with archaeological surveys, street plan and building remains.
properties.evidence: University of Nottingham and Greek Ministry of Culture survey, mapping and targeted excavation.
properties.cause: Coastal change and relative sea-level history; avoid a single unverified catastrophe narrative.

properties.name: Thonis-Heracleion
properties.period: Ancient Egyptian port, active before Alexandria
properties.summary: Excavated submerged port-city, with temple, harbor remains, statues and artifacts.
properties.evidence: IEASM excavations and Oxford Centre for Maritime Archaeology publications.
properties.cause: Delta sediment subsidence, sea-level change and localized ground liquefaction.

properties.name: Baiae
properties.summary: Submerged Roman villas, mosaics, port structures and architectural remains.
properties.evidence: Italian national environmental research agency's mapping and official tourism archaeological interpretation.
properties.cause: Bradyseism and coastal subsidence in the Campi Flegrei volcanic area.

properties.name: Port Royal
properties.summary: Earthquake-submerged sections of a historically documented port town, with surviving structures and urban plan.
properties.evidence: UNESCO World Heritage inscription and archaeological ensemble documentation.

properties.name: Atlit-Yam
properties.summary: Prehistoric submerged settlement with buildings, wells, burials and excavated occupation evidence.
properties.evidence: Peer-reviewed excavation, geoarchaeology and Israeli archaeological authority research.
properties.cause: Postglacial sea-level rise and coastal change.

properties.name: Yonaguni Formation
properties.summary: Submerged terraced rock formation promoted by some as architecture, interpreted by other researchers as geological.
properties.evidence: Photographed and dived rock formation; no consensus establishing human construction.
properties.interpretation: Physical formation is real; artificial-monument interpretation is disputed.
properties.cause: Natural jointed rock and erosion are among proposed explanations.

properties.name: Western Cuba Sonar Anomaly
properties.region: Off western Cuba, broad regional locator
properties.summary: Deep-water sonar and remotely operated vehicle imagery reported geometric rock patterns; a human-built city is unverified.
properties.evidence: Early expedition observations publicly reported in 2002; no cited peer-reviewed excavation establishing architecture.
properties.cause: No demonstrated submergence mechanism for a constructed settlement at reported depths.
